rules.text: One score, one reading, one next step.

from.quote: One score, one reading, one next step.

rules.text: Keep the title to one or two words: it's cut to one line.

from.quote: Keep the title to one or two words: it’s cut to one line.

rules.text: Say what the score means in one sentence.

from.quote: Say what the score means in one sentence

rules.text: Give the nudge one reason to act.

rules.text: Label the nudge's button with a verb, such as “Add accounts”; the default label is “Button”.

from.quote: label its button with a verb; the default label is “Button”.

rules.text: Do not leave the default label: the button reads “Button” and promises nothing.

from.quote: The button reads “Button” and promises nothing.

rules.text: Do not write a long title: it's cut to one line, so its end is lost.

rules.text: Do not put two actions in the nudge: a long label such as “Add accounts and review bills” squeezes the reason to act.

examples.purpose: A spending score with its reading and one next step, named for screen readers by the score in words.
examples.jsx:
<CardAdvisory
  title="Spending"
  description="You’re within the plan you set for this month."
  value={70}
  nudgeBody="Data confidence is low. Add more accounts for better insights."
  nudgeButtonLabel="Add accounts"
  onPressNudgeButton={() => {}}
  accessibilityLabel="Spending score 70"
/>

from.quote: “Spending”, what 70 means this month, and “Add accounts” as the next step, named “Spending score 70”.

examples.purpose: A score to act on, in red: Semantic Intent System with AppearanceSystem negative.
examples.jsx:
<CardAdvisory
  title="Spending"
  description="You’ve used most of this month’s plan."
  value={25}
  nudgeBody="Data confidence is low. Add more accounts for better insights."
  nudgeButtonLabel="Add accounts"
  onPressNudgeButton={() => {}}
  accessibilityLabel="Spending score 25"
  modes={{ 'Semantic Intent': 'System', AppearanceSystem: 'negative' }}
/>

from.quote: System with negative: red for a score to act on.

examples.purpose: Score only, after the screen's step is done: on the guide's Insights screen, once the accounts are linked, the screen hides the nudge with showNudge and updates the reading.
examples.jsx:
<CardAdvisory

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Without it, the card's root (no role) is named `${title}. ${description}. ${round(value)} out of 100. ${nudgeBody}`: the name includes the nudge text when the nudge is hidden, a double period after a description ending in “.”, and the unclamped value. Declared: Accessibility label for the full card.

props.name: title
props.description: Clamped to one line unless disableTruncation is set. Declared: Main heading text. Default "Spending", from the component source.

props.name: description
props.default: Track your spending habits and stay within your budget.
props.description: Wraps, with no line clamp. Declared: Description shown below the heading. Default "Track your spending habits and stay within your budget.", from the component source.

props.name: value
props.description: The ring clamps it to 0–100. Declared: Progress score displayed in the circular progress bar. Default 70, from the component source.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Replaces the number in the ring. Declared: Optional formatted score label.

props.name: showInfoIcon
props.description: Show the info icon beside the title. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: showNudge
props.description: Also gates nudgeSlot: with showNudge false, a nudgeSlot doesn't render either. Declared: Show the bottom advisory nudge. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: nudgeBody
props.default: Data confidence is low, add more accounts for better insights.
props.description: Body text for the default nudge. Default "Data confidence is low, add more accounts for better insights.", from the component source.

props.name: nudgeButtonLabel
props.description: Also names the nudge button for screen readers (aria-label on the web). Declared: Button label for the default nudge. Default "Button", from the component source.

props.name: onPressNudgeButton
props.description: Callback for the default nudge button.

props.name: titleEndSlot
props.description: Optional slot replacing the title info icon. Receives `modes` recursively.

props.name: progressSlot
props.description: The card forwards no supportText or state to its default ring. Declared: Optional slot replacing the circular progress bar. Receives `modes` recursively.

props.name: nudgeSlot
props.description: The card forwards no title, showClose, onClose or buttonSlot to its default nudge. Declared: Optional slot replacing the bottom nudge. Receives `modes` recursively.

props.name: modes
props.description: Reach the ring and the nudge; no mode changes the card's own surface or text. Declared: Design token modes forwarded to token lookups and child components.

props.name: style
props.description: Optional container style override.

props.name: mainContentStyle
props.description: Optional main content row style override.

props.name: titleStyle
props.description: Optional title text style override.

props.name: descriptionStyle
props.description: Optional description text style override.

props.name: progressStyle
props.description: Optional progress wrapper style override.

props.name: nudgeStyle
props.description: Optional nudge style override.

props.name: disableTruncation
props.description: Affects the title only, the card's one clamped text (Biscuit's unpublished 7020bf9 mdx says it also wraps the description and nudge text; the code does not). Declared: When `true`, disables text truncation: the trailing ellipsis (`…`) is never shown and any `numberOfLines` clamp is ignored, so the text wraps to as many lines as it needs even when horizontal space is tight.

props.name: ...CardAdvisoryBaseProps
props.description: Inherited React Native props the component also accepts. They are not part of the design contract and no guide documents them.

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: Colours the ring's arc and the nudge with its sparkle and button: Primary (the default) a gold arc and a cream nudge; Neutral a dark arc and button with a white nudge (Storybook); Secondary purple; Tertiary blue. The ring's track stays grey. Declared: A token collection CardAdvisory reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: AppearanceSystem
modes.description: With Semantic Intent System: positive green, warning orange, negative red, on the ring (its track too) and the nudge. Declared: A token collection CardAdvisory reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

gaps.text: No mode combination reproduces Figma's nudge on Card / Advisory: white, with a purple sparkle.
The title sits on a 32 px line in code (26 in Figma), so the main row is about 70 px tall against Figma's 64.
